text:
Alex: Thanks everyone for coming to the follow-up thread. A few people asked for concrete clarity on the headcount split and team moves we announced — I'll collect Qs here and loop in Jordan/People.
Jordan: Happy to answer — fire away.
Priya: I'll drop recruiting timelines and open reqs as we go.
Sam: Quick note — roadmap commitments we mentioned are still prioritized, but some timelines slip depending on hiring velocity.
Riley: Can you confirm whether the runtime team hires are net-new or internal transfers?
Jordan: Runtime hires are a mix — target ~6 net-new ICs over H1; we'll also rotate 2 people from eng-platform for knowledge transfer. We want core serving expertise in place.
Alex: Can you share the rough cadence for those transfers?
Jordan: Transfer window: opt-ins open next week, 2-week overlap for handoff. Expect 4–8 week transitions for critical roles.
Priya: Recruiting update: we've posted 8 new reqs today — 3 infra, 2 runtime, 1 product PM, 1 ML infra, 1 support. Priority tags set to P0/P1 in Greenhouse.
Riley: Any change to interview loops for the Dedicated/private infra roles?
Priya: Slight updates: added an architecture deep-dive panel for Dedicated hires. Loop now: recruiter screen -> hiring manager -> architecture panel (30–45m) -> take-home (optional) -> final cross-team.
Sam: On org structure — are we creating new subteams or shifting reporting lines?
Jordan: We're adding two sub-teams under eng-runtime: Kernel Optimization and Request Routing. Leads are provisional and will be hired/promoted from within. Reporting lines mostly stay within eng-runtime; some infra folks will have dotted-line to eng-platform for infra ops.
Leah: To reiterate from the all-hands — this is about concentrating expertise where latency/cost improvements matter most. We'll keep the broader product org intact.
Alex: Headcount numbers? High-level banding?
Jordan: High-level plan (H1):
```
Engineering total +12
  - Runtime +6
  - Infra +3
  - ML infra +2
  - Support/ops +1
Product +4
Sales & CS +2 (support dedicated capacity customers)
```
Alex: Is headcount bound to funding? Any hiring pause triggers?
Leah: No pause planned. We will monitor velocity and cost; leadership will revisit if market changes dramatically. For now, hiring stays on.
Riley: What's the plan for leveling and compensation for rapid promotions/transfers?
Priya: Promotions follow existing calibration. For expedited transfers with increased responsibility we have an "accelerated adjustment" workflow — expect comp decision within 2 pay cycles. I'll DM the managers the template.
Jordan: Regarding rollouts — if hires lag, we'll re-prioritize non-critical roadmap items and favor performance work that reduces costs.
Sam: Are we opening internships/university grads for runtime? Those are quicker to ramp and lower cost.
Priya: We are adding 2 new grad roles, yes. Hiring pipeline with campus partners opens in May.
Riley: When will team maps be updated? My team needs org charts for onboarding.
Alex: We'll publish a revised org chart and role matrix by Friday.
DeployBot: Scheduled: publish-org-chart job completed (artifact: s3://company-assets/org-charts/2026-03-27.pdf) :white_check_mark:
Jordan: On transitions — for anyone impacted, managers will have 1:1s this week. If you haven't heard, ping your manager and cc me.
Priya: Hiring transparency — I'll post a weekly tracker: open reqs, stage, recruiter, ETA to offer.
Riley: Any policy changes for internal mobility? I got questions about relocation/remote for Dedicated roles.
Priya: No policy changes. Remote-first remains; some Dedicated/customer-facing roles may ask for region alignment — we'll mark those on job posts. Relocation support stays at manager discretion for senior hires.
Alex: One more: are we creating any new manager roles or IC continues to grow?
Jordan: A couple of senior IC->manager conversions are planned where scaling requires people leadership. We will favor promoting from within where possible.
Leah: Appreciate the questions — this is a lot of change but it's targeted to reduce risk and speed up our serving improvements. We'll keep communication open.
Sam: Thanks — folks, if you have team-specific concerns, write to your manager or post in #people-ops so we can triage.
Alex: I'll close this thread tomorrow and summarize any outstanding Qs with action owners. Thanks for the rapid replies. :pray:
